subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should native `tag:md` become Feishu's default non-explicit-card behavior even though that changes shipped `renderMode: "auto"` and `markdown.tableMode` semantics?
rationale: The API now supports the desired carrier, but source and release history establish the current card/table behavior as an existing user-facing contract; code review cannot choose that upgrade policy without channel-owner intent.

options.title: Split and preserve defaults
options.body: Land inbound `content_v2` separately and retain automatic card routing plus table-mode conversion for existing outbound configurations.

options.title: Use an explicit native path
options.body: Expose native Markdown through an existing clearly documented mode or a narrowly approved opt-in while leaving upgrade behavior unchanged.

options.title: Approve the default switch
options.body: Intentionally replace the shipped behavior, remove or migrate the obsolete setting, update documentation, and require fresh-install plus upgrade and cross-client proof.

recommendation.title: Split and preserve defaults
recommendation.body: Land inbound `content_v2` separately and retain automatic card routing plus table-mode conversion for existing outbound configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with Chinese-channel ownership, including Feishu, and the unresolved question is channel product and compatibility policy.
